scope: Collector-specific SurveyJS behavior; not a full upstream API reference

general.native_vs_extension: SurveyJS owns the standard schema and rendering model. autoAdvanceIf, setsSurveyLanguage, fixedChoices and voice are Collector extensions, not upstream SurveyJS properties.
general.renderAs: renderAs selects a renderer for the same native question type; a non-native value requires the matching question package.
general.package_availability: Documentation is not deployment availability discovery. Confirm that a required package is installed, enabled and valid before applying a renderAs value.
general.auto_advance_priority: If any question has a non-empty autoAdvanceIf, Collector disables SurveyJS survey-level autoAdvanceEnabled (including its goNextPageAutomatic alias) for that model. If none do, the schema's survey-level setting is unchanged.
general.runtime: Live surveys, public and admin previews, and unsaved schema previews use the shared Collector SurveyJS runtime. Preview answers, current page and language survive reload in tab-local browser storage; a new navigation/tab starts fresh, including copied opener storage. Preview never reads or writes respondent responses. Live respondent-code continuation uses the authenticated public-survey database draft; anonymous live draft identifiers are tab-local. There is no newtest parameter.
general.html_safety: The shared runtime sanitizes final SurveyJS HTML and Markdown output with its configured DOMPurify protection. Schema HTML is not an execution API.

quotas.condition: Quota conditions (managed through the quotas routes, not schema mutations) use SurveyJS expression syntax over question names of the current effective schema, for example {gender} = 'f' and {age} < 35. Functions are not allowed.
quotas.quotaFullText: Survey-level Collector extension, localized in the same form as title (plain text, no markup; every survey language for headless interviews). Shown when a full quota ends collection for a respondent, on the web as the SurveyJS completion page and in interviews as quota_full_text. Without it Collector uses a built-in EN/ET/RU sentence. Set it with set_survey_settings.

quotaFullText.ru: Спасибо, ответов от вашей группы у нас уже достаточно.

voice.applies_to: Headless interviews only (interviewer API). voice is a Collector extension, not an upstream SurveyJS property; SurveyJS rendering ignores it. Absent voice keeps current behavior.

survey.intro: Translated text spoken once after the greeting, before the first question.
survey.estimated_minutes: Positive integer; interview responses also compute progress.
survey.instructions: Translated interviewer-only guidance for the whole questionnaire (tone, pacing, general rules); returned as survey_voice.instructions, never spoken.

question.instructions: The standard interviewer-note field for study managers: translated, interviewer-only guidance for this question (what to pay attention to, how to probe or code); never spoken. Example ET: "Pane tähele: kui vastaja mainib mitut põhjust, küsi peamist."
question.read_choices: Default read policy for choices without their own voice.read: always (default), never (respondent answers freely, interviewer codes it) or on_request. A rating with minRateDescription or maxRateDescription defaults to on_request; an explicit value wins.
question.hidden_choices: Unique existing choice values of a radiogroup or checkbox that are valid codes but never offered, such as don't know or refused. Equivalent to voice.read never on those choices; listing a choice whose own voice.read is not never is rejected.
question.rephrase: Translated alternative wording, used only when the respondent does not understand.
question.context: Translated background (why it is asked, who ordered it) for answering respondent questions; never read as the question.

choice.read: Per-choice voice.read on a radiogroup or checkbox choice: always (read when presenting the question), on_request (fallback such as don't know: not read initially, offered only when the respondent hesitates, asks or no option fits) or never (never offered, but saved when clearly stated). Choices without it use the question read_choices. Every returned choice carries read; hidden stays true for hidden_choices or own read never.

scale.descriptions: A rating may have translated minRateDescription and maxRateDescription (same form as title). Interview questions return scale {min:{value,text},max:{value,text},step} (text null when absent; scale null for other types).
scale.voicing: Describe a scale by its endpoints instead of enumerating numbers: read the question and endpoint texts; read the numbers only when the respondent asks.

rules: Translated values use the same object form as title and need nonempty plain text for every survey language; plain strings, markup, unknown keys and invalid values make the interview start fail closed.

Set voice through the ordinary guarded mutations: update_question_props for a question (including its choices), set_survey_settings for the survey. An optional translated page title is returned as the interview section.

Fallback-choice pattern: add don't know/refused as ordinary choices with voice.read on_request (offer when needed) or never (code only when volunteered), so the agent does not read them with the substantive options.

native.questionsOrder: Survey or page: initial (default) or random. Shuffles the questions within each page; survey level applies to every page, a page value overrides it (pages may also use default = inherit). A panel shuffles only its own elements, inheriting the page unless it sets its own. Pages are never reordered. questionOrder (the SurveyJS 3 name) is read as the same property; prefer questionsOrder.
native.choicesOrder: Any question with a choices array (interviews: radiogroup and checkbox): none (default), asc, desc or random. asc/desc sort by the displayed text in the current language.

extension.fixedChoices: Collector extension: a list of existing choice values that keep their schema position while the other choices are shuffled (typically Other, Don't know, None at the end). Allowed only with choicesOrder random; every value must be a choice value and listed once.

randomization.stability: Randomization is applied once per response from a seed and then stays fixed for that response: web reload and draft restore, interview back, next, language change, repeat and next-question lookahead all show the same order. The seed is stored as the response's randomization_seed and exported; the order a respondent saw is reconstructible as randomizeSchema(schema at that revision, seed). Per-question order lists are not stored.
randomization.interviews: A page whose questions are randomized must not reference another question of the same page (visibleIf, choice visibleIf/enableIf or {placeholders} in titles, descriptions, choice texts or scale texts); such schemas fail closed with unsupported_schema and the path. Conditions that reference earlier pages remain fine.
rules: Set these through the ordinary guarded mutations: update_question_props for choicesOrder/fixedChoices, upsert_page for a page questionsOrder, set_survey_settings for the survey questionsOrder.
Fixed-choice pattern: put Don't know last in choices, set choicesOrder random and list it in fixedChoices.

general.coverage: This is the first detailed Collector extension guide for radiogroup questions, not an encyclopedia of every SurveyJS property or question type.

rules: This is a reusable behavior of the native radiogroup, not a new SurveyJS type or a visual theme. No additional package is required for the native renderer.

Set setsSurveyLanguage to the JSON boolean true on a top-level radiogroup. Omitted or false leaves ordinary question behavior unchanged. Only one enabled language-selection question is allowed per page; nested panels and dynamic-panel templates are not supported.

Use unique static choice values that are lowercase two-letter codes from the survey supported_languages, with native-language labels. Other, None and remote/copied choices are not supported. Make the question required by default.

On successful forward page navigation, the answered visible editable language question on the previous page sets the SurveyJS locale, shared page-shell locale, URL lang and subsequent saved response language. Answer selection alone does not change the current page language.

Failed or cancelled navigation does not apply the language. Going Back preserves the current language; changing the answer and going forward applies the new selection. Unsupported or empty answers never switch language.

Works with manual Next and successful autoAdvanceIf navigation. setsSurveyLanguage does not itself enable automatic navigation. It does not switch language on final-page completion, readonly rendering or initial data restoration. Keep the selector before another page and use normal page navigation.
The same behavior runs in live and preview modes. Preview never saves responses. Existing translations are selected, not generated; provide the target-language survey texts.
It can be combined with renderAs cards when core/radiogroup-cards is installed, enabled and valid. The behavior does not depend on that visual renderer.

setsSurveyLanguage.discovery: GET /api/external/surveyjs-guide?question_type=radiogroup; inspect data.question_types.radiogroup.extensions.setsSurveyLanguage. To identify a configured question, GET its /questions?name=...&page=... and inspect question.type plus question.setsSurveyLanguage; overview omits extension properties.

rules: The property is accepted only on type radiogroup, including a radiogroup rendered with renderAs cards.
A missing property or empty string disables the extension; the string true enables it for every otherwise permitted native radio selection.
Any other non-empty string is evaluated as a SurveyJS condition against the current survey answers.
A JSON boolean, null, number, array or object is invalid; do not coerce it to a string.
The expression is checked again after 300 ms and immediately before native nextPage(). Invalid expressions fail closed and manual navigation remains available.

Auto-advance requires one visible, answerable, editable question on the current page, a changed native pointer or touch radio selection, a non-empty answer, no active Other/comment clarification, a following visible page and successful native SurveyJS validation.

Asynchronous validation is guarded: if the answer, page, visibility, locale or editability changes while it runs, its later automatic navigation or completion is vetoed; custom page-changing handlers leave this extension manual.

The feature does not complete the last page, does not react to keyboard arrows or Space, restored or prefilled data, triggers, expressions, programmatic setValue, language changes or dynamic-panel template questions.
questionsOnPageMode inputPerPage, questionPerPage and questionOnPage are outside this first version; continue with native manual navigation.

conditions.meaning: Unconditional after a changed native radio selection.
Advance only when the selected value is yes.
SurveyJS boolean and comparison expressions may combine answer conditions.
